questions.text:
“….., but these traits are better developed in cats.” (Paragraph 2)
The word of traits could best be replaced by …..
questions.explanation: Characteristics (karakter/ciri-ciri/sifat) adalah persamaan kata dari traits (karakter/ciri-ciri/sifat).

questions.text: These following statements are true, except .....
options: Cats are considered as “perfect carnivore” with teeth and particular digestive tract.
Cats cannot adapt to a vegetarian diet because they cannot synthesize all the amino acids that they need from plant material.
Cats have mingled with human life since at least 600 BC.
The cat is one of the most popular pets in the world.
questions.correctAnswer: Cats have mingled with human life since at least 600 BC.
questions.explanation: Pada paragraf ketiga disebutkan bahwa kucing-kucing sudah berbaur dengan manusia setidaknya sejak 6000 tahun SM, dari kerangka kucing yang ditemukan di pulau Cyprus.

questions.text:
“Inside, the building is as magnificent as it is from the outside.” (paragraph 4)
Which one of the following words is the antonym of magnificent?
questions.explanation: Execrable (sangat buruk) adalah lawan kata dari magnificent (mengagumkan). Pilihan A, B, C dan D salah karena bukan lawan kata dari magnificent.

questions.text: These following statements are true, except ....
options: Burj Khalifa has 163 floors, which is 16’2” (about 5 meters) for each floor.
There are four entrances to the tower of Burj Khalifa.
There is a big artificial lake that measures up to 12 hectares at Burj Khalifa.
The interior of the Armani hotel, located on the floors from first to 39th, was designed by Giorgio Armani himself.
57 elevators work 24 hours each day to transport visitors between floors at Burj Khalifa.
questions.correctAnswer: There are four entrances to the tower of Burj Khalifa.
questions.explanation: Pada paragraf ketiga disebutkan bahwa ada 3 gerbang masuk ke dalam bangunan “There are three entrances to the tower, because it is so huge that one or two would not be enough”. Pilihan A, C, D dan E salah karena sudah sesuai dengan teks.

questions.text: What can we inferred about from the last pharagraph?
options: People behave according to what they see around them.
People are like a vast municipal rubbish tip.
questions.correctAnswer: B. People behave according to what they see around them.
questions.explanation: Karena disebutkan pada paragraf 4 "Yet we know that people respond to their environment. If things around them are clean and tidy, people behave cleanly and tidily. If they are surrounded by squalor, they behave squalidly" Yang sesuai dengan kesimpulan pada opsi B yakni orang-orang berprilaku sesuai dengan apa yang mereka lihat disekitarnya.

questions.text: What can be inferred about the “Cambodia” according to the passage?
options: It has Khmer, and Vietnamese architecture
It’s home of the world’s largest temple complexes.
questions.correctAnswer: C. It’s home of the world’s largest temple complexes.
questions.explanation: Karena disebutkan pada paragraf 2 “... Angkor Thom, near present day Siem Reap, the site of the world’s largest temple complexes...” Sesuai dengan opsi C yang menyatakan Kamboja adalah rumah bagi komplek kuil terbesar di dunia, dimana komplek ini berlokasi di sekitar Angkor Thom dan Siem Riep yang merupakan bagian dari Kamboja.

questions.text: What is the closest meaning of the word "ensure" in the last paragraph?
questions.explanation: Ensure means to make certain that something will occur or be the case, which is closest in meaning to guarantee.

questions.text: The following statements are true in the passage, except?
options: Most people visit Siem Reap because it is close to temples.
Angkor Wat was the capital of the Cambodian empire
Dawn and dusk are particularly good times to visit Angkor Wat.
You will need a couple of passport photos.
The US dollar is widely accepted in Cambodia.
questions.correctAnswer: Angkor Wat was the capital of the Cambodian empire
questions.explanation: According to the text, the ancient capital of the Cambodian empire was Angkor Thom, not Angkor Wat.
